methods.label: Checking the definitions
methods.explanation: Integers include positive integers, 0, and negative integers. Fractions are rational numbers. When classified by sign, rational numbers fall into 3 categories: positive numbers, 0, and negative numbers. 0 is not positive.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 definitions and classifications of rational numbers, including the special status of zero.
